earliest_activation: S105, only after the S104 Phase-2 gate extension (R2-LNS-1.0) is committed on main and the code hashes below are re-verified
target: zero-sumfree indexed sequence of length 58 in (Z/20)^3; under recorded upper bound 59 this would force D(C20^3)=59
method: R2-LNS-1.0: exact large-neighbourhood remove-k/add-(k+1) deficiency repair. k=1 neighbourhood swept exhaustively per visited state (all distinct removed values, 2-addition existence decided for all first additions at once via exact FFT new-coverage: T extends by two iff some legal a has |Sigma(T)|+newcov_T(a)<|G|); k=2 sampled (12 removal pairs, first addition over up to 64 lowest-coverage legal elements, last two levels by the FFT test); found additions pushed through the exact oracle; otherwise tabu plateau swap (remove x, add legal a!=x not tabu) and uniform regrow; restart after 200 non-improving iterations.
material_difference_from_R1: R1 = random ruin(2..6) + softmin-coverage regrow with length-only acceptance. R2 = systematic exact neighbourhood decision (exhaustive k=1, enumerated k=2) driven by Sigma-complement / extension criterion, uniform (not coverage-biased) growth, tabu plateau walk, and a structured seed family (standard e1^(n-1)e2^(n-1)e3^(n-1)) for half the workers. Not a parameter tweak of R1.
search_domain: all finite indexed sequences over (Z/20)^3, repetition allowed; engine only ever holds zero-sumfree sequences (oracle-legal pushes)
symmetry_reductions_proved_and_used: none used; CLM-0345(d) invariances recorded but no normalisation applied
heuristic_restrictions: k<=2 neighbourhoods only; k=2 sampled and first-addition capped at 64; plateau moves random; this explores a heuristic neighbourhood only

budget.concurrency_note: CAM-0004 and CAM-0005 may run concurrently: 12 processes on 16 logical CPUs

checkpoint_format: JSONL: start record (params, param_hash, init_len), checkpoint every 50 iterations (best_len, cur_len, canonical best sequence + SHA-256, length histogram, move statistics), CANDIDATE_QUARANTINE record if target reached, end record (status, iterations_done, best, both checker verdicts, move statistics)
restart_procedure: runs are deterministic in (seed, init, iterations); a crashed worker is re-run from iteration 0 with the same seed and the crash recorded; partial logs kept, never merged as if complete
stopping_rule: per worker: iteration budget exhausted, walltime cap hit (logged WALLTIME_CAP_TRUNCATED, round counted partial for that worker), or target reached (stop, quarantine). Campaign round complete when all workers end.
budget_sizing_basis: S104 component timing only (no target-group search): rebuild of a length-L prefix ~1.2-1.6 ms, one FFT new-coverage 0.4-0.9 ms at n15/n20; worst-case k=2 phase ~12*64 pushes+FFTs per iteration. Iteration count chosen so 1200 iterations are expected below the 7200 s cap; truncation, if it occurs, is reported as such.
preflight: sessions/S104/LNS_PREFLIGHT.json: settled groups n=3,4,5,6 only; 120 FFT two-addition decisions agree with exhaustive oracle enumeration; best length exactly 3n-3 for both seed families; determinism PASS
on_hit: write candidates/<id>/sequence.json canonical sorted triples + SHA-256, rerun checker A and B standalone, mark CANDIDATE only; Lean 4 kernel proof + later-session cold recheck before any certification; no external disclosure without owner authorisation
result_semantics: budget exhaustion without hit is NOT evidence of nonexistence and NOT a negative result; k1_locally_maximal counts are exact statements about visited states only, not about the group
code_sha256_note: SHA-256 of LF-normalised file bytes (identical to the git blob content); .gitattributes pins tools/zsf/*.py to eol=lf
